vocabulary.definition: The physical form in which a medicine is produced.
vocabulary.example: A tablet is a solid dosage form.

vocabulary.definition: A formulation ingredient other than the active substance.
The process by which a substance goes into solution.

quiz.question: Which term is defined as: The physical form in which a medicine is produced.
quiz.explanation: dosage form means The physical form in which a medicine is produced.
